title: NDP 2026: Getting into the Show
description: NDP's Good Afternoon. A contractor accidentally ran a script that wiped the production database. You have 3 hours before the gates open. The last backup is 6 hours old. Go.
storyContext: 1:30pm, NDP afternoon. Someone ran a cleanup on the wrong system and all the live data is gone. Last backup is 6 hours old. Gates open at 4:30pm. Three hours to bring it all back.

software-engineer.title: Rescue the Data
software-engineer.instruction: The live data was just wiped. Restore it before gates open — one wrong step and it's gone for good.
software-engineer.hint: Stop the bleeding first. Figure out what's lost. Fix it carefully. Only go live when you're sure everything checks out.

items.label: Stop all new activity so nothing else gets corrupted
Compare what's left against the backup to see what's missing
Restore the backup into a safe test area — not live
Replay the last 6 hours of recorded activity to recover recent changes
Verify everything, then switch the live app over

data-scientist.title: Recover the Missing Info
data-scientist.instruction: The wipe erased 6 hours of user activity that marketing needs for their campaign. Raw records exist in another system but they're messy. What's your plan?
data-scientist.hint: Good enough on time beats perfect too late. But ask yourself — is the lost data even the most valuable data right now?

options.label: Rebuild everything from raw records. Takes 2 hours, but marketing gets complete numbers.
Use a sample to estimate the missing numbers in 30 minutes. About 85% accurate.
Skip it. Set up better tracking for the actual show — that data matters more anyway.
Ask marketing to cross-check their social media numbers against whatever you salvage.

cloud-engineer.title: Rebuild the System
cloud-engineer.instruction: The whole system needs to come back online. Slot 1 comes first. Slots 2 and 3 run together. Slot 4 is your final check.
cloud-engineer.hint: The thing everything else depends on must come back first. What can't the app work without at all?

items.label: Traffic Director — spreads visitors across machines
Main Storage — holds all app data
Backup Storage — handles lookups when main is busy
Speed Memory — remembers common answers to reduce load
App Workers — handle requests from phones
Health Monitor — watches everything for problems
